_label: GRAVITY SEARCH DESIGN for the ranked next patient, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. Design only -- no GPU was used and none was taken from the HCLI resident. This is what to run when a window opens.
_evidence: MEASURED organ masses from safetensors headers; the EBPW ladder below is arithmetic over those measured masses, not an estimate.
why_this_patient: the only body in the lake that is simultaneously MoE with a small active fraction, code-specialised (HCLI's actual domain), and long-context. Its expert organ is 94.95% of the model, so R-sparse-active-expert-gather's binding condition (expert mass >= ~0.9) is satisfied decisively -- unlike Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which failed that rule at 68.5% expert mass.

measured_organ_masses.note: embed_tokens and lm_head are BOTH present and tie_word_embeddings is false -- genuinely untied here, so the tied-embedding dedup lever does NOT apply to this body.

what_the_arithmetic_says.the_trap: pushing ONLY the experts is not enough. Experts at 2 bits with everything else left at BF16 still lands at 2.71 EBPW -- above the <2.5 entry rung -- because the 5.05% non-expert remainder costs ~0.8 EBPW on its own at BF16. This is exactly the BitNet lesson measured earlier this session: BitNet's linear weights are 2.0 bits and its COMPLETE system is still 3.91, because embeddings and norms stayed BF16. Always keep the complete system in the denominator.
what_the_arithmetic_says.entry_rung_<2.5: experts 2 bits + non-expert 8 bits = 2.3 EBPW (8.2 GiB).
what_the_arithmetic_says.qualified_rung_<=1.5: experts 1.5 bits + non-expert 4 bits = 1.63 EBPW; experts 1.0 + non-expert 4 = 1.15 EBPW reaches the PREFERRED <=1.0 rung, but only if capability survives at 1-bit experts, which nothing here has tested.

search_order_cheapest_discriminator_firs: 1. NEGATIVE CONTROL FIRST, before any codec: 0.01xW on the expert organ. If the verifier accepts a magnitude-destroyed organism the verifier is inadequate and every later number is void. This is mandatory per the Byte Elimination Law and costs one run.

2. Organ ablation to rank sensitivity: the router gate is 0.04% of mass but gates everything -- R-protect-router-if-sensitive says measure its sensitivity before touching it, and at 0.04% protecting it entirely is nearly free regardless of the answer.
3. Expert-only quantisation sweep (4/3/2.5/2 bits) with the non-expert organ pinned at BF16, to isolate the expert organ's own capability curve without confounds.
4. Only then the non-expert organ, because the ladder above shows it becomes the binding term once experts drop below ~2.5 bits. Attention qkvo is 3% and embeddings 2%.

5. Shared-basis / expert-delta structure LAST: 128 experts x 48 layers is the largest repeated structure in the lake at this scale, and it is where a representation win beyond quantisation would come from -- but it is also the most expensive search, so it should follow the cheap sweeps that bound what is achievable without it.
gather_prediction: active fraction 11.0% measured; gather ceiling is 1 - non_expert_fraction = 94.95%, so a native expert-gather should move nearly the whole per-token byte traffic. Per O005's tps_caveat the win may not show in TPS if decode is kernel-bound rather than bandwidth-bound -- that caveat is the reopen condition, not an excuse to skip the measurement.
gated_on: GPU. The HCLI resident holds it and S007 forbids interrupting an active cycle for Odyssey work. This design is the deliverable that makes the window cheap when one opens.
